question: Bilhan was a court poet in which of the following kingdoms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikramaditya VI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Vikramaditya VI, whose court poet Bilhan wrote his biography, was the ruler of the Chalukya dynasty.

 
• The Chalukya dynasty was established by Pulakeshin I in 543.
